author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists are testing a single injection of CTX310, a gene-editing nanodrug using CRISPR-Cas9, to disable the ANGPTL3 gene and reduce bad cholesterol and triglycerides. Early clinical trials in the US and China show promising long-lasting lipid control, potentially replacing daily statin pills.  

Source Article: 

https://newsroom.clevelandclinic.org/2026/08/28/cleveland-clinic-first-in-human-trial-of-crispr-gene-editing-therapy-shown-to-safely-and-continuously-lower-cholesterol-and-triglycerides-after-one-year
